Thus the group generated by these endpoint words is contained in \(O(6)\subset U(6)\) and cannot be all of \(U(6)\), even modulo overall phase. This claim is exclusively about **coherent unitary controls obtainable by composing the endpoint macros**, not about the original non-real H75 measurement/reset channel \( \Phi_\mu\) or general nonunitary protocols interspersing that reset.

**EXACT CONDITIONAL POSITIVE:** Suppose, as **additional independently provided physical control resources**, there are continuously tunable pulse Hamiltonians \(H_W,H_F,H_B\) corresponding to the three previously fixed endpoint macros \(W,F_{\mathrm{fb}},V_B\), not merely the right to apply the three completed gates. Their three skew-Hermitian normalized infinitesimal generators generate \(\mathfrak u(6)\) over \(\mathbb R\). Under standard driftless independent piecewise-constant signed control-amplitude assumptions, this gives ideal six-level \(U(6)\) coherent controllability. It is NOT a theorem that the original H75 source, P3 closure–residue filtration, frozen P6, or the generative map F supplies the three analog control ports or a means to interrupt the H75 reset.

This sharply separates a **gate-catalog authorization certificate** from a **Hamiltonian-port authorization certificate**, beyond H81/PRs #169–#171's source-only nonselection.

## 1. Endpoint-only O(6) obstruction

Let \(E_{jk}\) be standard site units, \(S=S_{01}=E_{01}+E_{10}+E_{22}\) be the real symmetric site SWAP, and \(A=E_{01}-E_{10}\), \(B=E_{21}-E_{12}\) real skew matrices. The registered endpoints are
\[
W=\begin{pmatrix}3/5&-4/5\\4/5&3/5\end{pmatrix}\otimes I_3,\quad
F_{\mathrm{fb}}=|0\rangle\langle0|\otimes I_3+|1\rangle\langle1|\otimes S,
\]
\[
V(x,y)=I_2\otimes (I_3+xA)(I_3-xA)^{-1}(I_3+yB)(I_3-yB)^{-1}
\]
at \(V_A=V(1/4,0)\), \(V_B=V(0,1/2)\), \(V_{AB}=V(1/4,1/3)\). The Cayley transform of any real skew-symmetric matrix is real orthogonal whenever the inverse exists. \(W\) and \(F_{\mathrm{fb}}\) are manifestly real orthogonal. Therefore *every finite word* in these endpoints and inverses is real orthogonal. O(6) is closed and proper in U(6), so even its topological closure cannot contain e.g. \(\mathrm{diag}(i,1,1,1,1,1)\), including up to scalar phase. A real endpoint **word of arbitrary length** cannot simulate arbitrary complex relative phases.

The fact that the original H75 reset contains a non-real \(U=\mathrm{diag}(i,1,i)O\) does not make its CPTP instrument a continuously tunable coherent unitary port. This no-go does **not** apply to all conceivable protocols that may make additional nonunitary interventions or new coherent ports.

## 2. Three analog generators and exact full \(\mathfrak u(6)\) bracket theorem

The normalized real Lie-algebra generators for **conditionally furnished analog Hamiltonian controls** are:
\[
J_W=\begin{pmatrix}0&-1\\1&0\end{pmatrix}\otimes I_3,\quad
J_F=i\,|1\rangle\langle1|\otimes(I_3-S),\quad
J_B=I_2\otimes(E_{21}-E_{12}).
\]
All three are skew-Hermitian (and nonzero). Their matching endpoints are
\[
W=e^{\theta J_W},\qquad F_{\mathrm{fb}}=e^{(\pi/2)J_F},
\qquad V_B=e^{\varphi J_B},
\quad \theta=\arctan(4/3),\quad\varphi=2\arctan(1/2).
\]
Only the **endpoints** are registered in the preceding H75 access catalog. The interpolation \(e^{tJ_F}\) for arbitrary times (as well as \(e^{tJ_W},e^{tJ_B}\)) is an extra continuous-control hypothesis and cannot be silently inferred from access to the three fixed endpoints.

**Theorem (EXACT rational Lie-rank certificate).**
\[
\boxed{\operatorname{Lie}_{\mathbb R}(J_W,J_F,J_B)=\mathfrak u(6),\quad
\dim_{\mathbb R}=36.}
\]
**Finite proof certificate:** form iterated commutators starting with the three integer Gaussian generators and greedily retain linearly independent brackets of current generators with original \(J_W,J_F,J_B\). For \(X=A+iB\in\mathfrak u(6)\), \(A\) is a real skew-symmetric 6×6 matrix and \(B\) a real symmetric 6×6 matrix; concatenate the 15 upper off-diagonal entries of \(A\) and the 21 upper-with-diagonal entries of \(B\) to obtain **36 real coordinates**. All generated coordinates are exact integers (no irrational coefficients). With the deterministic BFS selection algorithm in the companion test, one gets 36 bracket vectors of lengths at most 7, with counts by bracket length:
\[
(3,2,5,6,10,7,3)\quad(\text{length }1,\ldots,7).
\]
The 36×36 coordinate matrix has determinant residue
\[
\boxed{\det V\equiv 754500\pmod{1000003}\ne0.}
\]
Therefore \(\det V\ne0\) over \(\mathbb Z\), so the 36 brackets are independent over \(\mathbb R\); every bracket belongs to \(\mathfrak u(6)\), whose real dimension is 36. Equality follows. This is a finite exact modular certificate; float SVD, numerical Lie-rank heuristics or unavailable experimental calibration are not used to prove rank.

**Conditional controllability consequence:** Under **independently sourced** freely signed, tunable piecewise-constant control Hamiltonians proportional to \(iJ_W,iJ_F,iJ_B\), negligible/switchable drift, known carrier frame, and no unavoidable reset during pulses, the corresponding driftless system has reachable unitary group \(U(6)\) by the standard Lie-rank controllability theorem for compact connected groups. The group-theoretic statement is exact under these assumptions; pulse durations, amplitudes, cost, decoherence, imperfect switching and hardware feasibility are not provided by the source.

## 3. Strongest relevant distinction

\[
\underbrace{\langle W,F,V_A,V_B,V_{AB}\rangle\subset O(6)}_
{\text{EXACT fixed endpoint resources}}
\qquad\text{but}\qquad
\underbrace{\operatorname{Lie}_{\mathbb R}
\langle J_W,J_F,J_B\rangle=\mathfrak u(6)}_
{\text{EXACT if analog Hamiltonian resources are imported}}.
\]

There is no contradiction: a fixed reflection \(F=e^{(\pi/2)J_F}\) is **real**, while intermediate fractional-angle pulses \(e^{tJ_F}\) typically have nonreal matrix entries. The analog continuous family contains physical operations **not** certified by merely possessing the fixed endpoint F.
